abstract: Maintains mobilization insurance schedules and commercial brokerage evaluations
system_message:
You are the Marine charter broker (COMM), responsible for maintaining mobilization insurance schedules, commercial brokerage evaluations, and port logistics records for candidate expedition support vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Harbor turn-around duration（PORT）
information_points.content:
COMM-PORT-JKS：The standard provision turnaround time for SV Thracian Explorer at the Port of Naples bunkering berths is recorded as 48 h between offshore voyages.
COMM-PORT-UEI：Port logistics agreements for the Port of Naples bunkering berths establish a standard provision turnaround time of 36 h for RV Aegaeo Endeavour.
COMM-PORT-QSF：Under the Port of Naples bunkering berth agreements, the standard provision turnaround time for MV Poseidon Horizon between offshore voyages is 24 h.

information_points.title: Maintains mobilization insurance schedules and commercial brokerage evaluations（EVAL）
information_points.content:
COMM-EVAL-1GL：According to the Baltic Exchange peer appraisal summary covering the past 36 months, MV Poseidon Horizon holds a vessel charter broker industry reputation score of 78 points on the commercial reliability and charter compliance index.
COMM-EVAL-D0S：Based on Baltic Exchange peer appraisal fleet records across the prior 36 months, RV Aegaeo Endeavour has attained a vessel charter broker industry reputation score of 96 points.
COMM-EVAL-RH6：SV Thracian Explorer carries a vessel charter broker industry reputation score of 78 points per the 36-month Baltic Exchange peer appraisal index evaluation.
